facts.fact: On 6 May 2026 the interior ministry, with the support of Ladec, presented and demonstrated the digital civil-status platform and biometric identity card production; the permanent secretary named electricity and internet coverage in all registration centres and health facilities, training and card-production kits as challenges still to be met.

The Ministère de l'Intérieur, du développement communautaire et de la sécurité publique presented the platform, with the support of Ladec (Land and development expertise center) and in the presence of the Swiss cooperation office; the permanent secretary called on all partners to accompany the process.
